page.thaumcraft_example.intro: This tab, research and mixed page come from an independent addon. Text flows and wraps in page coordinates.
page.thaumcraft_example.flow: The relay stores up to 64 essentia and 10 vis (1000 centivis). Connect it to a loaded energized-node network. Right-click to inspect it. Unloading a chunk removes it from the network and retains its saved contents.
page.thaumcraft_example.meter: Custom Java page: data is validated on both sides; rendering and interactions use only the client API.
